_comment: AUTHORED per-command override list (design section 2, layer 2).
Where the host gates individual commands inside a both-registered
handler, the override row makes the mirror refuse typed-with-redirect
at command granularity instead of passing the host's raw ServerError
through. Every row is LIVE-PINNED by a wrong-context invoke in
session_context_browsertest.cc - the host MUST refuse where a row
claims it does; drift between row and host fails the test, so this
list cannot rot silently. Commands without a row dispatch: the
mirror is exactly as wide as the host.

overrides.hostGate: content system_info_handler.cc GetInfo - refuses non-browser sessions
content system_info_handler.cc GetProcessInfo - refuses non-browser sessions
